messages:
suresh: Bringing up Sora-v1 on staging. did a quick multilang smoke and zh/ko/arabic look off — token boundaries and some RTL punctuation reordered. anyone else seeing this?
keiko: can you paste a minimal failing pair? example input + sora-v1 output vs baseline?
suresh: sure — reproducer below. run was on q4f16 quant build:```bash
./eval_run --model=sora-v1 --quant=q4f16 --suite=multilang/translate_smoke --src=tests/mix_width_bidi.txt --out=tmp/sora_out.json
```
keiko: thanks. curious if this is quant-only or a tokenization mismatch. quick numbers?
maya: ran diff on a sample set — BLEU zh: 28.7 -> 21.3, chrF: 56.2 -> 48.1. ko similar-ish. for ar we see punctuation moving before RTL runs (eg. ":" ends up before word). looks like a detokenization/ordering problem. :thinking_face:
liam: could be new pretokenizer in the tokenizer bundle we shipped with Sora. did the model card include tokenizer v3?
suresh: yep model card listed tokenizer v3 with the "mixed-width-normalizer" enabled. i tried forcing tokenizer v2 and the outputs align with baseline (BLEU back to ~28). so likely tokenizer change + quant interaction.
keiko: can you paste one concrete example? short input and two outputs (baseline vs sora-v1)?
suresh: example: INPUT: "我喜欢在早上喝茶。"
BASELINE: "I like to drink tea in the morning."
SORA-V1 (q4): "I like to drink tea morning in ."  <-- dropped particle order, extra space before punctuation
ANOTHER_INPUT_AR: "مرحبًا بالعالم!"
BASELINE_AR: "Hello, world!"
SORA-V1_AR: "Hello , world!" <-- space before comma, and comma moved left of RTL span
maya: that space-before-punct is classic detok mismatch. i suspect the pretokenizer's ZWJ/ZWSP handling changed. quant could amplify by merging subtokens differently.
liam: good call. can we reproduce with FP16 sora-v1 (no quant) but tokenizer v3? if yes then quant is secondary. if only with q4 then it's quant kernel.
eval-bot: eval-run 3456-2026-03-20T14:32 finished. regression flagged: mixed-lang-translation (score delta > 6 BLEU).
suresh: reproduced: FP16 + tokenizer v3 also shows ordering issue, but less severe. q4 increases token merges around punctuation. so root cause = tokenizer v3 normalization change; quant worsens symptoms.
keiko: plan: roll tokenizer back to v2 for canary, open a test-case PR with the two examples, add mixed-width+RTL test to smoke. also add a small bisect script for quant merge cases.
maya: i'll add the test harness and permalinks to the examples in the eval repo. can you tag me on the PR? i'll queue dedicated infra for the canary runs.
suresh: created branch "sora/tokenizer-revert" and test PR draft, linking samples. will run canary next.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: sora-v1 tokenizer revert -> staging at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z.
liam: sweet. once canary passes, we should add an automated mixed-direction test to the pre-deploy gate so this doesn't slip again. :thumbsup:
maya: ack, i'll put the test under evals/locale/mixed_direction/sora_smoke.json and add to the nightly regression job.
keiko: thanks team — this one was subtle but glad it was reproducible.
suresh: thanks all, will update the PR with FP16 vs q4 artifacts. ping if you want the raw token lists.
liam: please also record the tokenizer change in the model card diff so Oncall + Support can triage similar reports faster.
suresh: noted, adding changelog entry.
